programme.desc: When Cool Joe's guitar skills go viral, he must choose between playing the match against Cosmos FC or a concert with a funk legend! Meanwhile, Shakes gets help from his little sister to dig deeper into the mystery surrounding his past.

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: Entertainment guru Ms. Altivo convinces Shakes and Skarra to swap teams on her new reality show. But as hidden cameras capture every moment, the show seems to bring out the worst in Skarra... and in Shakes too!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi on a sense-ational journey! He visits a garden to discover his five senses, exploring the flavors of fruit and colors of flowers. His nature-filled day continues at a gorgeous greenhouse where he plants a seed and learns how water, nutrition and sunlight help plants grow. He names all the colors and learns about flowers, picking a beautiful bouquet.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's time to learn all about animals with Blippi! First, he's at the Party Jungle indoor playground to learn about amazing animals like elephants, monkeys and more! Then, Blippi explores the Northwestern Trek, an amazing park in Washington! Blippi goes on an adventure around the park, teaching kids all about the native animals, from bald eagles to bears, mooses to elks and so much more!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a nature walk and some of his favorite rhymes! First, JJ's family shows him all the fun things we can do to help the Earth, like sorting trash for recycling. Then, the kids go on a nature walk with Bingo, collecting fun information in their scrapbooks! After the outdoor fun, it's time for classic rhymes. Sing along as ten animal friends try to share a bed and help the three little kittens who have lost their mittens!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Spend a whole day with JJ, from morning to night! Wake up and get ready with the family as JJ learns his morning routine. Then, it's off to a big adventure: JJ's first day of preschool! He's a little nervous, but he makes new friends and has lots of fun. After a full day of playing, it's time to get ready for bed. Mommy guides JJ through his nighttime routine of brushing his teeth, taking a bath and reading a story before he drifts off to sleep.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a fun day at Jumper Jungle indoor playground! On a day of sporty play, Meekah finds different sports balls, including a basketball and a soccer ball. As she collects them, she searches for the best place to play each sports game. Then, it's a day of bouncy play! Join Meekah as she bounces around the inflatable play structures and bounces like a bunny, frolics like a frog and hops like a hare!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a bouncy day of sports and play! First, she jumps and plays her way through Sky Zone Trampoline Park. She climbs play structures, goes down slides and even tests her ninja skills in the ninja course! Along the way, she meets some special dino friends! Then, Explorer Meekah searches for shapes and learns about the different balls used in sports. She goes around the indoor playground discovering new ways to bounce, roll and dunk them!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering about animals on an ultimate adventure! Join Blippi and his robot friend FETCH as they travel the world to get their questions answered. How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning awesome facts about all kinds of animals! He and D.BO travel back in time to meet the biggest dinosaurs, like the Argentinosaurus, and even try to keep a T-Rex as a pet for a day! Back in the present, they shrink down to count a shark's teeth with a pilot fish dentist. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how elephants use their trunks to keep cool and discovers why cats have whiskers from a local feline celebrity.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He and D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors and why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert and helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: Oddbods: Short
programme.desc: Oddbods follows the wacky adventures of seven unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected consequences.

programme.desc: Suspended from the team, Shakes uses the time off to investigate his father's disappearance on Mt. Kilimanjaro. While evading a mad snowboarder and an avalanche, Shakes can't help but monitor his teammates' every move from afar.

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: In a last-ditch effort to stay in the running for the final, Coach drops his team in the Amazon for some wild training. Shakes is amped, but El Matador isn't himself. Who is he?! And what does a mysterious photographer have to do with it?

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: All set to play Iron Tank for a place in the final, Supa Strikas can't resist a no-rules pick-up game aboard a massive tanker. But when an uninvited guest steers the ship towards disaster, will they rise above rivalry and work together?

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi is having loads of fun at LOL Kids Club! Join him as he visits two of their amazing locations. In one colorful playground, Blippi will teach us about lots of different shapes, colors, animals and more! Then, at another LOL Kids Club indoor play place, Blippi learns through playing! He'll help us learn about colors, shapes, size comparison and so much more! It's a day packed with learning and laughter!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi on a prehistoric adventure! He's visiting an incredible dinosaur exhibition to learn all about these magnificent creatures from the past. Blippi gets to see giant dinosaur skeletons, look at lifelike models, and learn the names of different dinosaurs, from the mighty T-Rex to the gentle Brachiosaurus. It's a dino-mite journey back in time!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Go on a big animal adventure with JJ! The fun starts on Grandpa's farm, where JJ learns all about the animals and the sounds they make. He even helps give a sheep a bath! Then, it's time to head to the ocean. Join JJ and his family as they visit an aquarium and sing 'Baby Shark' with a real shark family! The adventure gets prehistoric when Ms. Appleberry teaches the class all about their favorite dinosaurs. From guessing games to meeting Bingo the dog, it's a wild day!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ and his friends for a fun school day at Melon Patch Academy! Ms. Appleberry finds exciting ways to learn, like using building blocks and drawings to practice the alphabet. Then, the kids play a fun guessing game to learn all about the five senses and how to sign them in ASL! The learning continues as they sing about the days of the week, play a fun alphabet photo game on a rainy day and enjoy story time with the whole family. It's a day packed with learning and fun!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of science experiments with Meekah! First, she visits the Glazer Children's Museum, where she plays a fun game of sink or float, serves customers in the play restaurants and builds a fort, all while counting! Then, Blippi and Meekah visit the Ontario Science Centre to learn about gravity and electricity. They build a rollercoaster, see water react to music and even see a Hot Air Balloon!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a bouncy day of sports and play! First, she jumps and plays her way through Sky Zone Trampoline Park. She climbs play structures, goes down slides and even tests her ninja skills in the ninja course! Along the way, she meets some special dino friends! Then, Explorer Meekah searches for shapes and learns about the different balls used in sports. She goes around the indoor playground discovering new ways to bounce, roll and dunk them!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he and D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made and join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science and new friends!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun and healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. Then, shrink down with Blippi and Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-quiet night in Oddsville! When a power cut strikes, all the Oddbods seek refuge at Fuse's house, ruining his plans to watch the big game. Then, a funky asteroid lands in the cul-de-sac and emits groovy pop music that puts everyone in a dance trance! The chaos continues when one of Newt's eggs gets zapped at the store and hatches into an adorable but monstrously hungry chick!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing some tricky problems! Newt discovers an abandoned bird egg and hopes to hatch it, but she is distressed to discover that Fuse is tasked with chopping down the tree it's in! Then, a snowy day gives Pogo the perfect chance for new pranks, but he goes too far and is sent to a boot camp to learn discipline. Plus, Newt struggles with building a flatpack treehouse and gets some unwanted 'help' from Fuse.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's time to get active with Blippi! First, Blippi and Meekah head to a skate park to learn about skateboarding. With their helmets on tight, they discover tricks to stay balanced. Then, Blippi is ready to take on the tiniest sport there is... mini golf! He learns that it takes a lot of practice and precision. He also practices his tennis skills on the court, working on his serve and playing with friends, just like the tennis players at Wimbledon!

Meekah explores Dino's Alive, seeing cool big dinos and searching for the birthday girl!

Then, they find a magical phone on the ground and start taking selfies and playing music, but things quickly get out of hand. The magical mayhem continues when a pot of ink changes their color, turning them into fugitives on the run from the bug police!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Get ready for a wild ride of random antiks with Joey and Boo! The adventure begins when they take a leaf for a boat ride but get chased by a hungry fish. The random fun continues as Boo falls into a pot of invisible ink, they find a house made of gingerbread that a spider also wants and they discover a tiny toy racecar that takes them on a wild ride they can't control!

programme.title: Wakaf
programme.desc: Farhan a small child who survived the incident of black magic has been equipped with religious knowledge at Islamic boarding schools. He returned to seize family rights and fight for the mosque that has been donated for the benefit of the people. His uncle wants to sell the land and used an evil genie to destroy Farhan. Farhan is looking for clues to expel the jinn and is trying to awaken his uncle. Tragically, he is tortured with the supernatural powers. Will he escape the torturing?

programme.title: Pintu Neraka
programme.desc: Kamasani, a business tycoon with terminal cancer seeks Mahabub, a mysterious recluse rumoured to possess a cure. After treatment, Kamasani feels his cancer reducing but starts having serious side effects where he starts to hallucinate and become violent. When a TV reporter uncovers Mahabub's supernatural conspiracy that involves prominent names, Kamasani realizes that people have died or suffered because of his refusal to accept his own fate and vows to set things right.

programme.title: Kawan Aku Mati Dalam Rumah Sewa
programme.desc: Rudy is a film extra who is always playing ghost characters. Akhiruddin is a petrol station attendant. Remy shines shoes along the five-foot ways around the city. The three of them rent a house from Pak Cik Osman but they are three months behind in rent. One day, Pak Cik Osman's nephew Saipol, an illegal motor racer, comes to put with them for a while. That night, Saipol wins a race and goes home with RM10,000 in cash on him. Rudy so happens to get home at the same time, still in his vampire costume. Saipol is so frightened that he has a heart attack and dies on the spot. Akhiruddin and Remy follow behind and the three bachelors start panicking over what to do with Saipol's corpse. Will Saipol come back to haunt them and get back the money?

programme.title: The Free Fall
programme.desc: Sara discovers her mom stabbing her dad with a knife before slicing her own throat. After a failed suicide attempt, the traumatized young woman awakes from a coma with total memory loss, only to be greeted by her husband, Nick, whom she has no recollection of. She tries to piece together the events that led to her attempted suicide and to get accustomed to her new life, but reality grows murkier everyday until she is unsure what is real and what is not.

programme.title: Malaysian Ghost Stories S2 Ep09
programme.desc: Nusantara is a place full of mystical spirits and the supernatural. Each episode has a unique solution depending on the type of disturbance, the type of genie and the effect on the main character.

programme.title: I Wish I Wish aka Deseo Deseo
programme.desc: Five cousins reunite at the house of their recent deceased grandmother. As they rummage through her belongings, they discover a curious board game titled 'I Wish, I Wish (Deseo, Deseo).' Out of boredom, they decide to play the game together. The rules are simple: each player may ask 3 wishes that will be fulfilled after completing a challenge presented by the game. If they carry it out they will have what they desire; otherwise there are far reaching consequences. The players soon learn the game truly grants their wishes -- at a heavy cost. For those who have chosen not to fulfill the challenge, the game releases a vicious creature to enforces punishment on their loved ones. The group soon discover that they must keep playing, and risking others is the only way to save themselves.

programme.title: The Spirit of Ramayana
programme.desc: In order to prove herself to her family, 24-year-old contemporary dancer Mintra auditions for a new play called "Ramayana", hoping to land her dream role Seeda. But the director deems her too nice for the role, which portrays contrasting sides of good and evil. Instead, her rival Gina is chosen for the role, awakening resentment in Mintra and prompting her to accept the offer of a female ghost to help bring out her dark side.

programme.title: X-Game
programme.desc: Based loosely on a horror novel, four kidnapped university students become entangled in a revenge story born out of past bullying. Hideaki took part in a bullying game in his elementary school called 'X Game' where unsuspecting victims picked their fates from a lottery list of pranks. Imprisoned together with three other classmates from the elementary school, they are made to play a new type of ' X Game .' This time around, however, the bullying is much, much worse.

programme.title: Pintu Neraka
programme.desc: Kamasani, a business tycoon with terminal cancer seeks Mahabub, a mysterious recluse rumoured to possess a cure. After treatment, Kamasani feels his cancer reducing but starts having serious side effects where he starts to hallucinate and become violent. When a TV reporter uncovers Mahabub's supernatural conspiracy that involves prominent names, Kamasani realizes that people have died or suffered because of his refusal to accept his own fate and vows to set things right.

programme.title: Phone
programme.desc: Soon after getting a new phone, an investigative reporter named Ji-won begin receiving a series of disturbing calls. To escape the terrifying and relentless ringing of the phone, she changes her number and moves out to her sister's home. But the threatening campaign of terror continues, even as Ji-Won unravels the mystery behind the phone.

programme.title: Dukun
programme.desc: Lawyer, Karim, is searching for his missing child, Nadia. His desperation leads him to be entangled with an alleged murderer, Diana Dahlan. In the process of defending her, Karim learns uncomfortable secrets about his missing wife and child that may cause him to lose everything. A gory bloodfest that interweaves politics, greed, black magic, decapitation and dismemberment, and demon possesions, this horror film is loosely based on the real and gruesome murder of politician, Datuk Mazlan Idris, by Mona Fandey, a washed-up singer-turned-witch doctor who was convicted in 1993. Originally slated for release in 2007, its controversial subject matter forced the film into cold storage, until it was finally shown in 2018.

programme.title: Buyut
programme.desc: Based on an urban legend amongst the Bangka Belitung community, Buyut is a mythological creature or water ghoul that lives in the bodies of water. The story begins when a newlywed couple Bima and Kanaya move into a home bought from an auction after its previous owners passed away. After a while, Kanaya begins to notice odd happenings occuring in their new home.

programme.title: The Boy Behind The Door

programme.title: Faces Of Anne
programme.desc: Anne woke up alone on a mysterious island with no recollection of who she is or how she got there. The staff in the building she woke up in claims that she is in a hospital recovering from her amnesia. Now, she must quickly figure out how to survive and escape from her predicament.
